_note: FL27 registry fragment: watermia (scenes $78-$7F = decimal 120-127) and euro (scenes $91-$9D = decimal 145-157). Scratch flags are keyed by scene; the eight persistent spine flags ($8D $94 $96 $9D $9F $A7 $A8 $AC) are proposals only (FL31 writes the records). The names of the persistent owned flags are guessed from the dialog around the set sites unless the notes say the code proves them. Flags $0280-$028B (hidden Red Jewels of scenes $78 $7B $91 $9D) belong to FL12 and are cross-referenced in _crossref.
_crossref: $0288 wa_watermia_hidden_jewel_taken, $0289 wa_gambling_house_hidden_jewel_taken, $028A eu_euro_hidden_jewel_taken, $028B eu_dark_chapel_hidden_jewel_taken (FL12): hidden_red_jewel placements in this scope (tables/scene_actors.asm:2874 scene $78 type #11, :2908 scene $7B type #13, :3263 scene $91 type #15, :3369 scene $9D type #17; $0E = type >> 1 = 8, 9, A, B; flag = $0E + $80 on event-flag base $0200). The inventory trace hidden_red_jewel_flags lists the same four rows (candidate indices 648 649 650 651, one scene each: 120, 123, 145, 157). wa79_lance and eu95_ann jump into hidden_red_jewel.HiddenRedJewelInventoryFull when GiveItem reports a full inventory (extracted/watermia/lukes_house/wa79_lance.asm:87 {503071}, extracted/euro/rolek_mansion/eu95_ann.asm:60 {515926}) and keep their own flags ($E2, $E5) clear in that case.

Direct accesses of the scope that are not flag bits: the word $0AA6 (aliases global flag indices $0530-$053F, flags:tail) is the Russian Glass bitmask of wa78_glass_game: cleared at spawn (extracted/watermia/watermia/wa78_glass_game.asm:55 {495723}); the bits $04 $10 $02 $08 $01 are the five glasses in the order the opponent drinks them (ORA at :75 {495784}, :105 {495869}, :135 {495956}, :163 {496038}, :191 {496119}; every one of the five glass children ORs the same bit when the player drinks it at :462 {497878}, :504 {498177}, :538 {498241}, :572 {498299}; the fifth, bit $01, is tested at :593 {498338}). The same word is a phase counter in angel_village and nazca (FL26): two unrelated uses of one word. $0AB0 jewelsCollected (BCD) is incremented by wa79_kara (extensions of the inventory-full branch, extracted/watermia/lukes_house/wa79_kara.asm:64 {501179}, :67 {501186}) and wa7D_glass_opponent (extracted/watermia/glass_players_house/wa7D_glass_opponent.asm:56 {495052}, :59 {495059}). $0ACE playerHp := 0 at extracted/watermia/watermia/wa78_glass_game.asm:617 {498377} (answer Yes to the last glass); $0ACA/$0ACE +1 at extracted/euro/flea_market/eu97_life_medicine.asm:43 {511272}/:44 {511275}; $0B1C read and written by eu97_dark_medicine at :40 {511500}/:44 {511511}; $0ADE (playerStr) +1 at extracted/euro/power_house/eu93_found.asm:27 {517412}/:29 {517416}.

Scene entry: scene_flag_init (placed in scene $78 by tables/scene_actors.asm:2832) sets scratch $00 at spawn (extracted/actors/scene_flag_init.asm:16 {50794}); no other scene of this scope places it. Can I talk to you for a minute?', sets $04) -> Lily (waits $04, leaves with QueueMapChange #7F). meanings.name: eu_ann_apple_errand_started
meanings.summary: Ann's secret about the Jackal was answered 'No, please don't!' (or cancelled); Ann now asks for apples ('Aah. I want an apple. Let's go to the marketplace!').

effects.set: Ann's handler switches to the apple branch (code_07DF33).
effects.clear: Ann asks 'Should I tell Kara about it?' with rows 'If you must!' / 'No, please don't!'. Row 1 prints 'I don't like that Kara...' and sets nothing.

meanings.notes: DialogueOptions returns row + 1 (index 0 = cancel); the table is cancel -> code_07DF26, row 1 -> code_07DF2E, row 2 -> code_07DF26, so row 2 and cancel set the flag. Apples are sold at eu91_merchant_counter (one per player, no flag: BranchIfHasItem #28 at extracted/euro/euro/eu91_merchant_counter.asm:63 {508071}).

meanings.name: wa_lance_red_jewel_given
meanings.summary: Lance gave Will the Red Jewel in Luke's house after the party had been to Euro.

effects.set: wa79_lance prints 'I hope you get to see your father soon.'.
effects.clear: With $97 and $A5 set, wa79_lance prints dialogstring_07AEDE ('My father's getting better every day...') and GiveItem #01; the flag is set only if the give succeeds (a full inventory jumps to HiddenRedJewelInventoryFull and the flag stays clear).

meanings.notes: Index $E2 is also one of the 'seven NPC jewel gifts' listed in hidden_red_jewel's header; here the flag is the actor's own.

meanings.name: eu_ann_first_apple_given
meanings.summary: Will gave Ann the first apple ('Thanks. I can't eat any more.').

effects.set: The next apple goes to $E4.
effects.clear: The first apple sets this flag, is removed (RemoveItem #28) and Ann prints the thanks.

meanings.notes: Only eu95_ann reads and writes $E3 (fl_scope index E3: 2 sites).

meanings.name: eu_ann_second_apple_given
meanings.summary: Will gave Ann the second apple.

effects.set: The next apple gives the Red Jewel and sets $E5.
effects.clear: The second apple sets this flag, is removed and Ann prints the thanks.

meanings.notes: Reached only with $E3 set.

meanings.name: eu_ann_red_jewel_given
meanings.summary: Ann gave Will a Red Jewel for the third apple ('Good. As a present I'll give you this jewel.').

effects.set: Ann only says 'I'll take care of Kara...'.
effects.clear: With $D6 set and an apple, the third apple removes the apple, prints dialogstring_07E10A and gives item $01; the flag is set after the give.

meanings.notes: RemoveItem #28 runs before GiveItem; a full inventory jumps to HiddenRedJewelInventoryFull ({515926}) and the flag stays clear, so the apple is spent and a further apple is needed (the next talk, with $E3 and $E4 set and no apple, prints dialogstring_07E0DE which repeats the 'I want an apple' text). Queue FL27-14.

meanings.name: eu_life_medicine_taken
meanings.summary: Will drank the Life Medicine in the flea market (+1 max HP, +1 HP).

effects.set: The interact handler prints 'I'm sorry... One to a customer.'.
effects.clear: 'This is Life Medicine. Try some?' rows Yes/No; Yes sets the flag, increments playerMaxHp and playerHp, prints 'Your power is increased!' and the actor dies.

meanings.notes: Free of charge (no money check in the file). The actor is not killed by the flag at spawn: it dies after the drink and reappears with the flag set on the next load.

meanings.name: eu_dark_medicine_taken
meanings.summary: Will drank the Dark Medicine in the flea market (Dark Friar power raised).

effects.set: eu97_dark_medicine dies at spawn.
effects.clear: Yes: if $0B1C is 2 the actor prints 'The Dark Friar's power is strong enough!' and leaves the flag clear; otherwise it writes $0B1C := 1, sets the flag and prints 'Freedan's Dark Power has increased!'.

meanings.notes: $0B1C is the Dark Friar power level by the dialog ('The Dark Friar's power is increased!'); the write of #1 even when the value is already 1 is as coded. The meaning of $0B1C values was not traced here.
